"[Study Name/ID pre-filled]" - sponsor/study placeholder meant to be pre-filled by the study, not by the clinician at the visit; administrative. Shares the paragraph with the "Site Name:" answer area, which must be filled without disturbing it.
"ME/CFS CDE Version 1.0" form version text in the footer (used by both sections).
"Page {PAGE} of {NUMPAGES}" fields; cached result in the file says 14 of 14 while the render has 15 pages - must stay live fields, never overwritten with literal numbers.
"Please specify how many minutes" above the Standing-for blank.
Comments column heading "If abnormal, explain or describe below" (repeating table header row on every page).

Printed instructions inside answer cells: "If palpable, describe here" (Liver, Spleen) and "Note if supraclavicular fullness present." (Lymph Nodes). Filled comments must go below them, not replace them.
Bracketed italic guidance for the Section 4 Impression.

difficulties: Almost every answer is a legacy FORMCHECKBOX (274, all unchecked) inside one long two-column table (Physical examination | Comments) that runs from page 2 to page 14; option labels (Normal/Abnormal, No/Yes, Yes/No, Absent/Present, ...) are printed once on a heading line and inherited by the following item lines, and the polarity flips between items (Neck Supple is Yes=1/No=2 but Masses is No=1/Yes=2; Pupils Yes/No). Several items inherit semantically odd headings (Thyroid Size under No/Yes, Photophobia under Normal/Abnormal). Alignment is done with long tab runs and, in places, runs of spaces, so labels, headings and boxes sit in separate paragraphs; the Lesions row mis-renders with its second box pushed out of view. Every body-system row and every grey summary row has a free-text Comments cell to the right, three of which already contain printed instructions. Section 1 vitals use per-digit glyph boxes (Symbol font char F0F0, rendered as dots) with decimal points - filling them means placing digits into fixed-width box positions, BP systolic and diastolic share one paragraph, Weight/Height and Waist/Hip share paragraphs, and Height is split into feet and inches. Header answer areas (Site Name, Subject ID) sit on the same header paragraphs as a sponsor pre-fill placeholder. A nested Pulses table (Left/Right) lives inside the Extremities cell. Section 4 is a separate Word section with 14 underscore tab-leader lines interleaved with spacing paragraphs. The form has no signature, date or examiner-name field.
unsupportable: None identified - no anatomical diagrams or drawing areas. The per-digit glyph boxes and the pulses grid carry no printed scale, so their exact expected format (e.g. pulse grade) is not defined by the form.
